# GSAP 3.15.0

Unmodified minified builds from the `gsap` npm package, version 3.15.0: the core plus ScrollTrigger, Flip, DrawSVGPlugin, MorphSVGPlugin and MotionPathPlugin.

GSAP is free for commercial use under Webflow's Standard "no charge" license: <https://gsap.com/standard-license>. The license headers in each file stay as shipped. Copyright GreenSock / Webflow.

The kit vendors these files so the handbook and scene projects work offline and render the same way every time. To upgrade, copy the same files from a newer `gsap` package, update this note, and rebuild.
